metrics.description: Flat scalar metrics used directly by the severity-band scorer. Submit 0 for each metric where no violation was found.

body_nesting_depth.description: SUI-1: max @ViewBuilder nesting depth in body and all view-returning computed properties

view_expression_count.description: SUI-1: count of distinct view expressions (Text, Image, HStack, ForEach, etc.) — modifiers excluded

impure_count.description: SUI-2: count of methods/computed properties classified as IMPURE (data fetch, transform, format, validate, compute)

max_modifier_chain.description: SUI-3: highest number of chained modifiers on any nested child view inside a @ViewBuilder closure

vm_injection_style.description: SUI-4: how the ViewModel dependency is injected — 'protocol' (compliant), 'concrete' (violation), 'none' (no VM present)

preview_only_count.description: SUI-5: count of file-scope views/types only referenced from #Preview or PreviewProvider

views_without_preview_count.description: SUI-6: count of file-scope View structs with no #Preview or PreviewProvider instantiation anywhere

bad_accessibility_count.description: SUI-7: count of container views with .accessibilityIdentifier but missing .accessibilityElement(children:)

fixed_frame_count.description: SUI-8: count of .frame() calls with literal numeric width or height values

over_isolated_count.description: SUI-9: count of types/protocols with @MainActor that have background-safe members or nonisolated escape hatches
